messages:
Ava: Hey folks! Quick holiday thing — we’re doing a 'Snowflake Card Swap' this year 🎴❄️. Sign up if you want to exchange cards (physical or e-card). Drop 'IRL' if you want to swap postal cards, 'E' for e-card only, or 'Either' if flexible. I'll collect addresses privately. Deadline: Dec 15. :party_parrot:
Ravi: IRL! I'll bring stamps to the NYC office :mailbox_with_mail:
Liam: E for me, but happy to do a handwritten card if someone covers postage :)
Maya: Either — remote but can do physical if someone coordinates pickups
Noelle: +1 to IRL, also can volunteer to organize the card bundling
infra-bot: Reminder: office pickup day set to 2025-12-20 14:00 UTC — see #lunch-plans for table assignment
Ava: Thanks all — replying with a quick template for addresses (DM me with this):
```
Full name
Preferred address (for IRL) or email (for E)
Pronouns (optional)
One-line holiday message you'd like included
```
Ravi: sent you mine, @Ava :white_check_mark:
Liam: sent!
Maya: sent and added my snail mail too
Noelle: sent. Also can make small stickers for the cards if we want :sparkles:
Ava: love the sticker idea :heart_eyes: — Any objections to me pairing people randomly? Or should we let people pick 1-2 preferences?
Liam: random is fun — keeps it low-effort :+1:
Ravi: random works
Maya: random please
Noelle: random FTW
Ava: Cool — I’ll randomize tomorrow and DM pairings. Also, tiny poll: would folks prefer a theme? Reply with 'Winter', 'Cozy', 'Space', or 'NoTheme'
Liam: Cozy
Ravi: Winter
Maya: NoTheme
Noelle: Cozy
Ava: Noted. Thanks everyone — happy holidays early! 🎄 If you have an allergy or prefer no glitter, DM me.
